cited_by.title: Dry, itchy, flaky scalp and dandruff

record.population: School children, elementary to high school (US)
record.design: Retrospective prevalence study of head lice
record.finding: Hispanic children had the highest rate of infestation, then Caucasian children. African American children showed a 15% infestation rate, which the authors say is not supported by other studies.
record.note: Conflicts with the 1977 study; unclear counting.
